user.title: Connect Xiaomi TV
user.description: Enter the TV IP address or local API URL.

pair.title: Pair your TV
pair.description: Open the app on your TV, select Pair with Home Assistant and enter the six-digit code.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the TV. Check its address, network and backlight permission.
error.invalid_code: Code incorrect, expired or pairing closed. Open pairing on the TV again.

abort.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the TV.

cannot_connect.message: Unable to reach the TV. Turn it on and check the connection.

invalid_level.message: Backlight must be a whole number from 0 to 100.
